title: MaterialProfile
description: Core material printing window, ventilation, and adhesion configurations.

cooling_fan_speed_pct.description: Extruder cooling fan speed percentage (0.0 to 100.0).

dryness_sensitive.description: True if the raw material absorbs ambient moisture easily (hygroscopic).

enclosure_recommended.description: True if an enclosure is recommended for this material.

max_bed_temp.description: Maximum recommended bed temperature in Celsius.

max_nozzle_temp.description: Maximum recommended nozzle temperature in Celsius.

min_bed_temp.description: Minimum recommended bed temperature in Celsius.

min_feature_size_mm.description: Smallest resolvable detailed dimension in mm.

min_nozzle_temp.description: Minimum recommended nozzle temperature in Celsius.

name.description: Readable name of the material (e.g. "Polylactic Acid").

warp_risk.description: Relative warp risk under standard airflow conditions.
